/-- Full-carrier byte law matched by the arbitrary-prestate native zip step.
All unselected bytes are retained on this same 32-byte array. -/
theorem frame (out : Array U8 32#usize) (limb : U32) (i j : Nat)
    (window : i<8) (index : j<32) :
    (out.setSlice! (4*i) (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).val).val[j]! =
      if 4*i ≤ j ∧ j<4*i+4 then
        (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).val[j-4*i]! else out.val[j]! := by
  have length := (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).property
  change (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).val.length=4 at length
  by_cases inside : 4*i ≤ j ∧ j<4*i+4

      (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).val (4*i) j (by scalar_tac)
    simpa only [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq] using mid

    by_cases early : j<4*i

        Array.setSlice!_getElem!_prefix out (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).val (4*i) j early
    · have late : 4*i+(core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).val.length≤j := by omega
      simpa only [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq] using
        Array.setSlice!_getElem!_suffix out (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).val (4*i) j late

namespace NBG_Utilities
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
def pack {α : Type} (a b c d e f g h : α) : Array α 8#usize :=
  Array.make 8#usize [a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h]

theorem shape {α : Type} (a : Array α 8#usize) :
    ∃ a0 a1 a2 a3 a4 a5 a6 a7, a=pack a0 a1 a2 a3 a4 a5 a6 a7 := by
  rcases a with ⟨xs,h⟩
  change xs.length=8 at h
  cases xs with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a0 xs =>
    cases xs with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons a1 xs =>
      cases xs with
      | nil => simp at h
      | cons a2 xs =>
        cases xs with
        | nil => simp at h
        | cons a3 xs =>
          cases xs with
          | nil => simp at h
          | cons a4 xs =>
            cases xs with
            | nil => simp at h
            | cons a5 xs =>
              cases xs with
              | nil => simp at h
              | cons a6 xs =>
                cases xs with
                | nil => simp at h
                | cons a7 xs =>
                  cases xs with
                  | nil => exact ⟨a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7,rfl⟩
                  | cons a8 xs => simp at h

theorem lists (xs ys : List U8) (width : xs.length=ys.length) :
    List.allM (fun (x,y) => do let b ← core.cmp.PartialEqU8.ne x y;ok (¬ b))
      (xs.zip ys)=ok (decide (xs=ys)) := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil =>
    cases ys with
    | nil=>rfl
    | cons y ys=>simp only [List.length_nil,List.length_cons] at width;omega
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases ys with
    | nil=>simp only [List.length_nil,List.length_cons] at width;omega
    | cons y ys=>
      have tail : xs.length=ys.length := Nat.succ.inj width
      by_cases same : x=y
      · subst y
        have comp : core.cmp.impls.PartialEqU8.ne x x=false := by
          simp [core.cmp.impls.PartialEqU8.ne]
        simp only [List.zip_cons_cons,List.allM,comp,bind_tc_ok]
        change List.allM _ (xs.zip ys)=ok (decide (x::xs=x::ys))
        simpa only [List.cons.injEq,true_and,liftFun2,bind_tc_ok] using ih ys tail
      · have comp : core.cmp.impls.PartialEqU8.ne x y=true := by
          simp [core.cmp.impls.PartialEqU8.ne,same]
        simp only [List.zip_cons_cons,List.allM,comp,bind_tc_ok]
        change ok false=ok (decide (x::xs=y::ys))
        simp [same]

#print axioms shape
#print axioms lists
end NBG_Utilities

def tag : K → U8 | .PrivateTransfer => 1#u8 | .Withdrawal => 2#u8

theorem tag_result (kind : K) :
    UScalar.cast .U8 (read_discriminant kind : U8) = tag kind := by
  cases kind <;> rfl

theorem slice_equal (a b : Slice U8) (width : a.val.length = b.val.length) :
    core.slice.cmp.PartialEqSlice.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8 a b =
      ok (decide (a.val = b.val)) := by
  unfold core.slice.cmp.PartialEqSlice.eq
  rw [if_pos width]
  exact NBG_Utilities.lists a.val b.val width

    (kind : K) : core.result.Result Unit E :=
  if bytes.val.take 4 ≠ magic.val then .Err .WrongMagic
  else if bytes.val[4]! ≠ 1#u8 then .Err .WrongVersion
  else if bytes.val[5]! ≠ tag kind then .Err .WrongTransitionKind

  simp [pool_v1.payment_relation.require_header,
    core.array.Array.index,core.ops.index.IndexSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice.index,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index,

  else if c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.pool ≠ c.master_account then .Err .MasterBindingMismatch

def touched (ws : List (Nat × Nat)) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ w ∈ ws, w.1 ≤ k ∧ k < w.1 + w.2

instance (ws : List (Nat × Nat)) (k : Nat) : Decidable (touched ws k) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ w ∈ ws, w.1 ≤ k ∧ k < w.1 + w.2))

def run {α : Type} (src dst : Nat → α) : List (Nat × Nat) → Nat → α

  | w :: ws => run src (loop src dst w.1 w.2) ws

theorem run_spec {α : Type} (src dst : Nat → α) (ws : List (Nat × Nat)) (k : Nat) :
    run src dst ws k = if touched ws k then src k else dst k := by
  induction ws generalizing dst with
  | nil => simp [run, touched]
  | cons w ws ih =>
    rw [run, ih, loop_spec]
    by_cases ht : touched ws k
    · have h : touched (w :: ws) k := by

  ∃ w ∈ ws, w.1 ≤ k ∧ k < w.1 + w.2

    by_cases ht : touched ws k

        obtain ⟨v,hv,h⟩ := ht
        exact ⟨v,List.mem_cons_of_mem w hv,h⟩
      simp [ht,h]
    · by_cases hw : w.1 ≤ k ∧ k < w.1 + w.2
      · have h : touched (w :: ws) k := ⟨w,List.mem_cons_self,hw⟩

theorem list_frame {α : Type} (dst src : List α) (start k : Nat)
    (fits : start + src.length ≤ dst.length)
    (outside : k < start ∨ start + src.length ≤ k) :
    (dst.setSlice! start src)[k]? = dst[k]? := by
  have hs : start ≤ dst.length := by omega
  have hroom : min src.length (dst.length-start) = src.length := Nat.min_eq_left (by omega)
  simp only [List.setSlice!, hroom, List.take_length]
  rw [List.append_assoc]
  have hlen : (dst.take start).length = start := by
    exact (List.length_take).trans (Nat.min_eq_left hs)
  rcases outside with before | after
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [hlen]; exact before)]
    exact List.getElem?_take_of_lt before
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by rw [hlen]; omega)]
    rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by rw [hlen]; omega)]
    rw [List.getElem?_drop, hlen]
    congr 1
    omega

theorem array_frame {N : Usize} (dst : Array U8 N) (src : List U8) (start k : Nat)
    (fits : start + src.length ≤ N.val)
    (outside : k < start ∨ start + src.length ≤ k) :
    (dst.setSlice! start src).val[k]? = dst.val[k]? := by
  change (dst.val.setSlice! start src)[k]? = dst.val[k]?
  exact list_frame dst.val src start k (by simpa only [dst.property] using fits) outside

theorem list_inside {α : Type} (dst src : List α) (start k : Nat)
    (fits : start + src.length ≤ dst.length)
    (inside : start ≤ k ∧ k < start + src.length) :

  have hroom : min src.length (dst.length-start) = src.length := Nat.min_eq_left (by omega)
  simp only [List.setSlice!, hroom, List.take_length]
  rw [List.append_assoc]
  have hlen : (dst.take start).length = start := by
    exact (List.length_take).trans (Nat.min_eq_left hs)
  rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by rw [hlen]; omega)]
  rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [hlen]; omega)]
  rw [hlen]

    apply list_inside
    · simpa only [src.property,dst.property] using fits

    · simpa only [src.property] using fits

abbrev Decode := NEQ_CommonDecode.DigestCall

def transferRun (common : CommonCall) (decode : Decode) (validate : TransferCheck)
    (b : Array U8 216#usize) : Result (core.result.Result T E) := do
  let h ← pool_v1.payment_relation.require_header b
    pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_PRIVATE_TRANSFER_STATEMENT_MAGIC .PrivateTransfer
  match h with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
  | .Ok _ =>
    if (b.val.drop 148).take 4 ≠ List.replicate 4 0#u8 then ok (.Err .NonZeroReserved)
    else
      let c ← common b
      match c with
      | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
      | .Ok c =>
        let r ← decode (NBP_Read.chunk b 152 (by decide))
        match r with
        | .Err _ => ok (.Err .NonCanonicalDigest)
        | .Ok r =>
          let z ← decode (NBP_Read.chunk b 184 (by decide))
          match z with
          | .Err _ => ok (.Err .NonCanonicalDigest)
          | .Ok z =>
            let p := transfer_public c r z
            let valid ← validate p
            match valid with | .Err e => ok (.Err e) | .Ok _ => ok (.Ok p)

    (b : Array U8 216#usize) : Result (core.result.Result W E) := do
  let h ← pool_v1.payment_relation.require_header b
    pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_WITHDRAWAL_STATEMENT_MAGIC .Withdrawal
  match h with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
  | .Ok _ =>
    let c ← common b
    match c with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
    | .Ok c =>
      let z ← decode (NBP_Read.chunk b 184 (by decide))
      match z with
      | .Err _ => ok (.Err .NonCanonicalDigest)
      | .Ok z =>
        let p := withdrawal_public c b z
        let valid ← validate p
        match valid with | .Err e => ok (.Err e) | .Ok _ => ok (.Ok p)

    NBG_PaymentValidators.transfer_result,bind_tc_ok]

    | Ok common =>

/-! Success inversion through the actual late-public encoder, preserving the
SAME candidate. Child encoders remain opaque; no call success is postulated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S2K.LateAdmission
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open pool_v1.pair_tree_profile pool_v1.pair_terminal

elab "s2k_unpair" : tactic =>
  Lean.Elab.Tactic.liftMetaTactic fun goal => goal.withContext do
    for decl in ← Lean.getLCtx do
      let type ← Lean.Meta.whnf decl.type
      if type.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2 then
        return (← goal.cases decl.fvarId).toList.map (·.mvarId)
    throwError "no product variable"

elab "s2k_uncase" : tactic =>
  Lean.Elab.Tactic.liftMetaTactic fun goal => goal.withContext do
    for decl in ← Lean.getLCtx do
      let type ← Lean.Meta.whnf decl.type
      if type.isAppOfArity ``core.result.Result 2 ||
          type.isAppOfArity ``core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow 2 ||
          type.isConstOf ``core.convert.Infallible then
        return (← goal.cases decl.fvarId).toList.map (·.mvarId)
    throwError "no result/control-flow variable"

theorem candidate (s : PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1) (before after : Slice U8)
    (h : encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1 s before = ok (.Ok (),after)) :
    ∃ bytes, encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 s.candidate_afterstate = ok (.Ok bytes) := by
  unfold encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1 at h
  simp only [Bind.bind, Aeneas.Std.bind, core.result.Result.map_err,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
    core.convert.FromSame.from] at h
  repeat' first
    | (solve | exact ⟨_,by assumption⟩)
    | (solve | exact ⟨_,rfl⟩)
    | (solve | cases h)
    | (dsimp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry] at h)
    | (s2k_unpair <;> simp_all only [Result.ok.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq])
    | (s2k_uncase <;> simp_all only [Result.ok.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq])
    | (split at h)

theorem validated (s : PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1) (before after : Slice U8)

  let expected ← lift (Usize.checked_add 688#usize 57607#usize)
  match expected with

      let header ← core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8)
        bytes {start:=0#usize,«end»:=688#usize}
      let decoded ← decode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 header
      match decoded with
      | .Err _=>ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData)

        let encoded ← encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 candidate
        match encoded with
        | .Err _=>ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData)
        | .Ok encoded=>

def normalized (c : NED_ReconstructCarriers.Common) (next : NEE_RawValidatorPrefix.R) : NEE_RawValidatorPrefix.R :=
  if c.master_account = zero ∨ c.checkpoint_account = zero ∨ c.selected_lane_account = zero
  then ok (.Err .NonZeroBinding)
  else if 8 ≤ c.output_lane.val then ok (.Err .InvalidOutputLane) else next

theorem result (c : NED_ReconstructCarriers.Common) (next : NEE_RawValidatorPrefix.R) :
    NEE_RawValidatorPrefix.gate (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon c) next =
    normalized c next := by
  unfold NEE_RawValidatorPrefix.gate normalized
  simp only [NBH_ArrayEq.source,bind_tc_ok,NED_StatementCarrierFields.master,
    NED_StatementCarrierFields.checkpoint,NED_StatementCarrierFields.selected_lane,
    NED_StatementCarrierFields.lane,decide_eq_true_eq]

  · by_cases hc : c.checkpoint_account = zero

open NEU_EmitModel
open NEU_PublicProjections (get)
def kindCode : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.historical_anchor.PoolV1TransitionKind → Nat
  | .PrivateTransfer => 1 | .Withdrawal => 2

def project (r : Output) (slot : Fin 8) (i : Fin 8) (j : Fin 32) (k : Fin 20) : Nat :=
  match slot.val with
  | 0 => kindCode r.transition_kind
  | 1 => (get r.master_account j).val
  | 2 => (get r.selected_lane_account j).val
  | 3 => r.output_lane.val
  | 4 => (get r.nullifier i).val
  | 5 => r.verified_afterstate.next_pair_index.val
  | 6 => (get r.verified_afterstate.next_root i).val
  | _ => (get (get r.verified_afterstate.next_frontier k) i).val

theorem complete (a b : Output)
    (point : ∀ slot i j k, project a slot i j k=project b slot i j k) : a=b := by
  have h0 : a.transition_kind=b.transition_kind := by
    have h := point ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
    cases ha : a.transition_kind <;> cases hb : b.transition_kind <;>
      simp_all [project,kindCode]
  have h1 : a.master_account=b.master_account := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨1,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h2 : a.selected_lane_account=b.selected_lane_account := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨2,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h3 : a.output_lane=b.output_lane := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨3,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h4 : a.nullifier=b.nullifier := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨4,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h5 : a.verified_afterstate.next_pair_index=b.verified_afterstate.next_pair_index := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨5,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h6 : a.verified_afterstate.next_root=b.verified_afterstate.next_root := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨6,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h7 : a.verified_afterstate.next_frontier=b.verified_afterstate.next_frontier := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro k
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨7,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩ k
  cases a with
  | mk ak am asl al an aa =>
    cases aa
    cases b with
    | mk bk bm bsl bl bn ba =>
      cases ba
      simp_all only

    project (derived s) ⟨0,by decide⟩ i j k = kindCode (AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.kind s) := rfl

    project (derived s) ⟨1,by decide⟩ i j k = (get (AspisR1.S2K.StatementAdmission.common s).master_account j).val := rfl
theorem alignment2 (s : Statement) (i : Fin 8) (j : Fin 32) (k : Fin 20) :
    project (derived s) ⟨2,by decide⟩ i j k = (get (AspisR1.S2K.StatementAdmission.common s).selected_lane_account j).val := rfl
theorem alignment3 (s : Statement) (i : Fin 8) (j : Fin 32) (k : Fin 20) :
    project (derived s) ⟨3,by decide⟩ i j k = (AspisR1.S2K.StatementAdmission.common s).output_lane.val := rfl
theorem alignment4 (s : Statement) (i : Fin 8) (j : Fin 32) (k : Fin 20) :
    project (derived s) ⟨4,by decide⟩ i j k = (get (AspisR1.S2K.StatementChecks.nullifier s) i).val := rfl
theorem alignment5 (s : Statement) (i : Fin 8) (j : Fin 32) (k : Fin 20) :
    project (derived s) ⟨5,by decide⟩ i j k = (AspisR1.S2K.StatementAdmission.common s).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index.val := rfl
theorem alignment6 (s : Statement) (i : Fin 8) (j : Fin 32) (k : Fin 20) :
    project (derived s) ⟨6,by decide⟩ i j k = (get (AspisR1.S2K.StatementAdmission.common s).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate.next_root i).val := rfl
theorem alignment7 (s : Statement) (i : Fin 8) (j : Fin 32) (k : Fin 20) :
    project (derived s) ⟨7,by decide⟩ i j k = (get (get (AspisR1.S2K.StatementAdmission.common s).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier k) i).val := rfl

  have room : W.val ≤ N.val-start.val := by omega
